answer: The reveal must open the same plume hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the orchard gate. Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. Copying becomes a race the farming party always loses, and producing 74 original texts is the only way to fill 95 aliases; the nadir log preserves both halves. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
